svg.title: Human regulatory proteins on a xenograft membrane
svg.desc: Investigational xenograft context. Gene panels differ; no fixed number of edits or routine clinical availability is implied. Human complement and coagulation proteins are distinct protective strategies. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.

g.inkscape:label: Human regulatory proteins on a xenograft membrane
Phospholipid bilayer: heads and paired fatty-acid tails
Plasma membrane; extracellular above, cytoplasm below
